title: Which Organ Can Regrow After Major Damage?
description:
One organ can restore its mass even after a large portion is removed.

The liver. Remaining tissue enlarges and cells proliferate to restore functional mass.

The removed lobe does not grow back like a salamander limb; the remaining liver compensates and regains volume.

The liver can recover from major loss, but repeated or severe disease can overwhelm this ability.
